title: Grizio
tagline: We're building a visualisation app for block-chain data. It mainly uses APIs from the Vega protocol and the subgraph from Enzyme.
description:
This project uses the vue framework with graphql components to fetch, process and render block chain data. It mainly uses APIs from the Vega protocol and the subgraph from Enzyme.

The project is a Web application hosted on Netlify and it will allow any protocol that has not yet indexed it's data to do so via APIs.
how_its_made:
I used Vega APIs, Dune Analytics, Enzyme subgraph, Graph QL packages and th Vue Framework to build th e web app (hosted on netlify).



The  APIs fetches the data while the custome vue scripts renders it to the frontend. The project is a Web application hosted on Netlify and it will allow any protocol that has not yet indexed it's data to do so via APIs.
